brief: GS FICC & Equities EOD color, 21 Sep 2026. S&P 500 rose 149bps to 7,764 (best day since 8/4), NDX +283bps, on 16.41bn shares vs 18.732bn ytd average, as geopolitical optimism ahead of the UN General Assembly and reported positive US/China talks ahead of Thursday's Trump/Xi summit drove the tape. Oil fell 483bps to $95.46 as Trump backed off a Houthi strike and voiced openness to diplomacy, and Hormuz crude/LNG flows hit a six-month high despite shipping constraints. META (+11.43%, best day in 17 months, +17% over 9 sessions) drove ~15% of the SPX gain on Meta Muse app momentum (No.1 US App Store, ~73,000 US downloads/day over its first 10 days), lifting inference-demand CPU names INTC +12.17%, AMD +9.95%, ARM +17.16%. Desk activity was light (3/10), finishing 22bps better for sale. Asset managers bought (tech/communications/macro demand) while hedge funds sold (macro/energy supply). The ~30bps implied move overrealized 5x as the desk saw short-dated upside buying, with clients seen as underpositioned. Dealers shifted long gamma and skew was crushed spot-up/vol-up. GS likes IWM 3m gamma near 2y vol lows. Clients bought 1m INTC call spreads on CPU capacity constraints.
